provenance.limitation: The legacy script preserved these seed, density, CMB-benchmark and strain numbers without a machine-readable source, covariance, JWST occupation likelihood, merger likelihood or common cosmological abundance calculation. This passport records that limitation and does not invent provenance.

legacy_rho_dm_Msun_Mpc3.definition: Historical reference dark-matter density used only to form a conditional seed trace

legacy_nanograv_strain_at_1_per_year.definition: Historical reference strain used for a conditional scaling exercise

legacy_smbh_chirp_mass_Msun.definition: Historical effective SMBH chirp-mass calibration for strain scaling

legacy_smbh_merger_density_Mpc_minus3.definition: Historical merger-density calibration for strain scaling

legacy_cmb_fraction_benchmark.definition: Historical comparison benchmark, not a likelihood or an abundance solver
